body.zh-Hant: 出身寒微，父為鞋匠、母為洗衣婦。1894至1899年就讀提夫利斯神學院，1898年加入提夫利斯的祕密社會主義組織，一年後因此被神學院開除。1904年回到高加索並加入布爾什維克；1912年進入黨中央委員會。出生年份見缺漏。
body.en: Of modest family (father a cobbler, mother a laundress), he attended the Tiflis theological seminary 1894–99, joined the secret socialist organisation of Tiflis in 1898 and was expelled from the seminary a year later as a result. He returned to the Caucasus in 1904 and joined the Bolsheviks; in 1912 he was called onto the party central committee. For his birth year see gaps.

body.zh-Hant: 1917年10月起任政治局委員，並任民族事務人民委員（1917–23）與工農檢查人民委員（1919–23）。1922年任黨中央總書記，藉此逐步加強對黨與國家機器的控制；列寧去世後與托洛茨基激烈鬥爭，1927年托洛茨基被開除後消滅黨內一切反對勢力，並推行農業集體化與強行工業化。
body.en: Politburo member from October 1917; people's commissar for nationalities (1917–23) and for the Workers' and Peasants' Inspectorate (1919–23). As general secretary of the central committee from 1922 he gained growing control of the party and state apparatus; after Lenin's death he fought Trotsky, and after Trotsky's expulsion in 1927 crushed internal opposition while pushing collectivisation and forced industrialisation.

body.zh-Hant: 1939年推動與納粹德國結盟，但未能因此免於德國的軍事侵略。自1941年起任政府首腦與武裝部隊統帥；Treccani 認為他在戰爭戰略制定上的實際作用有爭議且不確定。戰勝納粹德國使他獲得崇高的國際聲望，體現於出席德黑蘭、雅爾達、波茨坦會議。其後東歐各國建立共產政權。
body.en: In 1939 he promoted an alliance with Nazi Germany, which did not keep German military aggression away. He was head of government and commander of the armed forces from 1941; Treccani calls his real part in shaping wartime strategy disputed and uncertain. Victory over the Nazi-fascist forces brought him great international prestige, marked by his participation in the Tehran, Yalta and Potsdam conferences. Communist regimes were later installed in the countries of Eastern Europe.

body.zh-Hant: 1916年成為貴族院公爵議員，曾以西園寺公望隨員身分出席巴黎和會。其後任貴族院副議長（就任年份來源不一，見缺漏），1933年起任貴族院議長（Treccani 記至1937年）；1939至1940年任樞密院議長。
body.en: He entered the House of Peers as a ducal member in 1916 and attended the Paris Peace Conference in the suite of Saionji Kinmochi. He later became vice-president of the House of Peers (sources differ on the year; see gaps) and from 1933 its president (to 1937 per Treccani); he was president of the Privy Council 1939–40.

body.zh-Hant: 1937年組成第一次近衛內閣；同年7月盧溝橋事件後日中進入全面戰爭。他是新體制運動的中心人物，其後共三次出任首相，1940年大政翼贊會成立、簽訂日德意三國同盟。Treccani 稱他也主張日美接近，卻無法阻止軍部主戰派得勢。戰後被列為甲級戰犯嫌疑人，在逮捕前自殺。
body.en: He formed the first Konoe cabinet in 1937; after the Marco Polo Bridge incident that July Japan and China went to full-scale war. As a central figure of the New Structure movement he served three times as premier; in 1940 the Imperial Rule Assistance Association was set up and the Tripartite Pact signed. Treccani adds that he favoured rapprochement with the United States but could not stop the pro-war militarist current. After the war he was suspected as a Class-A war criminal and killed himself before arrest.

body.zh-Hant: 栽迪派（Zaydi）社群的領袖。美國國務院文件稱他自1904年起統治葉門；奧斯曼帝國於1918年解體後，他在後來成為北葉門的地區掌權。1930年代晚期起出現地下反對運動，1940年代中期人口中的主要部分已反對其統治。他於1948年2月17日遇刺，國會圖書館稱之為宮廷政變，由兒子艾哈邁德繼位。
body.en: Leader of the Zaydi community. A U.S. State Department document says he ruled Yemen from 1904; after the Ottoman Empire was dissolved in 1918 he took power in the area that became North Yemen. Underground opposition began in the late 1930s and by the mid-1940s major elements of the population opposed him. He was assassinated on 17 February 1948 — described by the Library of Congress as a palace coup — and his son Ahmad succeeded him.

body.zh-Hant: 1895年5月21日生於米卻肯州小鎮希基潘，是一名店主的長子，小學四年級輟學，在地方稅務所當書記。1913年十八歲時加入反抗韋爾塔軍事政權的叛軍。
body.en: Born on 21 May 1895 in the small town of Jiquilpan, Michoacán, the eldest son of a shopkeeper. He left school after the fourth grade and worked as a clerk in the local tax office. In 1913, aged eighteen, he enlisted with the rebels resisting Victoriano Huerta's military regime.

body.zh-Hant: 靠著卡列斯將軍的庇護在軍中快速升遷，1920年出任米卻肯州臨時州長，1928年當選州長。其間曾請假出任國民革命黨主席（1930–31），並任內政部長與戰爭部長（1933年）。卡列斯原本期待能控制他，1933年他被推為黨的總統候選人。各來源對部分任期年份不一致，見缺漏。
body.en: Helped by the patronage of General Calles he rose rapidly, became interim governor of Michoacán in 1920 and was elected governor in 1928. He took leaves to serve as president of the National Revolutionary Party (1930–31), as minister of government and as minister of war (1933). Calles chose him as the party's presidential candidate in 1933, expecting to keep control. Sources differ on some tenure years (see gaps).

body.zh-Hant: 1934至1940年任墨西哥總統。1935–36年他動員工會、農民團體與軍政人物，迫使卡列斯流亡。任內沒收約四千五百萬英畝私有土地，以村社（ejido）形式分配；1938年3月將英美石油公司國有化並成立國營石油公司 PEMEX。他也譴責歐洲、衣索比亞與中國的法西斯侵略，並大力支持西班牙共和國。
body.en: President of Mexico 1934–40. In 1935–36 he marshalled unions, peasant groups, generals and politicians to force Calles into exile. He confiscated some 45 million acres of private land and distributed it as ejidos; in March 1938 he expropriated the Anglo-American oil companies and created PEMEX. He condemned fascist aggression in Europe, Abyssinia and China and strongly backed the Spanish Republic.
